Medicine Department

Tuesday, March 16, 2021

2016 batch MBBS Competency driven evidence based formative assessment

 

DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL MEDICINE


FORMATIVE AND LAST SUMMATIVE ASSESSMENT OF MBBS



This is an evidence based formative and summative assessment of the learning competencies of  2016 MBBS batch posted in the department of Medicine online from May 2020 to March 2021 and ward postings from Feb 2021 to first week of March 2021.  The formative assessment is from each UG student’s  logged competency around patients (evidence) evaluated regularly from date of joining.

The formative assessment has been divided into non-verbal which assesses their competency in procedural domains including empathic communication and body language (video evidence links shared where captured ) and verbal which assesses their ability to communicate their patient centered work, evidenced in their day to day E logs .
